description:
Compare transcriptomic signatures between two drugs.
Data: Tahoe-100M pseudobulk differential expression (prepared by tools/prepare_tahoe.py) · table de_permissive — one record = one gene's DESeq2 contrast for one drug at one concentration in one cell line on one plate (replicate wells pooled).
Key: drug, concentration, concentration_unit, Cell_ID_DepMap, plate, gene_name.
Arguments: drug_a accepts tahoe drug (resolved; unknown -> error); drug_b accepts tahoe drug (resolved; unknown -> error); cell_line_id accepts depmap cell line (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.gene` counts genes; `_vbt.grains.drug` counts drugs; `_vbt.grains.cell_line` counts cell_lines; `_vbt.grains.drug_dose` counts drug_doses; `_vbt.grains.contrast` counts contrasts.
padj is adjusted within one drug, concentration, concentration_unit, Cell_ID_DepMap, plate family.
Missing rows are censored (padj >= 0.1): not significant or not tested.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Only contrasts with finite padj < 0.10 are stored; 76% of source rows have padj NA and were dropped.…

cell_line_id.description: Accepts depmap_cell_line; resolved to one depmap_cell_line (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

concentration.description: Results are per concentration; pass one value, or the call fails with incomplete_key when several apply.

concentration_unit.description: Results are per concentration_unit; pass one value, or the call fails with incomplete_key when several apply.

drug_a.description: Accepts tahoe_drug; resolved to one tahoe_drug (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

drug_b.description: Accepts tahoe_drug; resolved to one tahoe_drug (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

plate.description: Results are listed per plate; pass one value to restrict them.
